section_summary.extract_value: This section details the results of a 2x2 ANCOVA and subsequent mediation analyses. The ANCOVA assessed the effects of guilt and appearance vs. health manipulations on post-test state body anxiety, finding no main effects of appearance or interaction, but a strong effect of trait body anxiety. Mediation analyses, carried out using Mplus 7.4, indicated that post-test guilt mediated the effect of the guilt manipulation on post-test body anxiety, specifically for women in the guilt condition, with no such effect observed in the no-guilt condition. The critical role of guilt, rather than general negative emotions, was highlighted.
